_comment: Synthetic DORA Art. 18 RTS inputs, per scenario -- build-spec §6.5: 'say so in the docstring rather than pretending the numbers are real.' These are lab fixtures for the platform's example tenant, Meridian Pay (docs/00-scope.md §0.1.2: ~2,400 SME merchants, ~40M transactions/year, 11-country EU passporting), not measurements of a real incident. See classify.py for how these combine with the drill record's own real, measured fields (duration, data loss).

ns-restore._comment: Namespace-level delete+restore: a contained incident by design (one tenant workload, one region) -- these numbers are chosen to be plausible for that shape of fault, not tuned to force a particular classification outcome.
